snippet.title: Realm of Thoth - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Realm of Thoth - mapping jam for classic The First Encounter hosted by me on Serious Sam Classics discord server. Goal of this event was to develop a mappack with whole and unite story and weapon progression.

Download links: EN version - https://hobu40k.itch.io/realmofthoth
RU version - https://www.serioussite.ru/load/relam_of_thoth_classic_collective_mappack/29-1-0-3347
Version for Revolution: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3710746445

Maps were made by: Wolf, Laki, StormCatcher.77, Unserious Dude, Georgg, HoBu4oK, Maska.
Music used for this trailer - https://youtu.be/cP8b-fQjwhg?si=TU4ULY3D_f7Iq39h (edited by Gathan Kelleri). 
Special thanks: Omletus, Art-Serious, Ar2R-devil-PiNKy, JesterOfDestiny, SeriousSimon, Rakanishu

P.S. Version for revolution is scheduled due to porting issues =/
